description:
Organize events. Share ideas. Stay up-to-date on what matters most.

With “Hey Korva“ now in ChatGPT, you can engage with your community groups, prepare lessons, sign up for events and more all in natural conversation wherever you are. Everything important becomes accessible by saying, “Hey Korva” or using @korvaconnect in ChatGPT.

Use Korva Connect to:
• Share posts with your groups
• Upload documents and search saved knowledge
• Create signups for events, meals, and volunteers
• Get feedback with anonymous polls
• Explore Scripture with references
• Ask questions using information you or your group can access

Korva Connect is a shared knowledge and coordination platform for people to get things done together. Turn your group’s scattered posts, documents, plans, and information into useful context for everyone with permission to access it, wherever they are.

defaultPrompt: Create a bible study on Genesis and save it as a PDF then upload it to my Group
Create a signup for Moms Night Potluck
